ideas.hook: A row of short rounded dashes curving upward that fuse into one smooth solid stroke at the top
ideas.means: Counted repetitions add up to fluid, regained movement

review.reading: a dashed arc turning solid: a loading spinner or progress indicator

ideas.hook: Three overlapping translucent-looking rounded blades fanned from one pivot, each opened a little further
ideas.means: Range of motion widening session by session

review.reading: three overlapping rounded blades fanned from a pivot: a colour-swatch fan or petals; overlap transparency is fragile in one colour

ideas.hook: Two parallel soft ribbons moving in the same wave, one slightly ahead of the other, never touching
ideas.means: Therapist guiding, patient following — moving together between appointments

review.reading: two parallel waves: generic water/audio/insurance swoosh, no specific form

ideas.hook: A resistance band drawn as one thick rounded loop stretched into a long tilted lozenge, pinched at one end
ideas.means: The physio's everyday tool, held under gentle tension

review.reading: a rubber band / paperclip loop: the product's own object and a loop, near Hinge's looping H

ideas.hook: A balance cushion seen from the side: a soft dome with a small round weight resting just off-centre, about to roll
ideas.means: Balance training and the confidence of a steady, active step

review.reading: a circle resting on a dome: the generic user/person avatar icon (body imagery)

ideas.hook: A time-lapse of one rounded bar swinging up: three ghosted positions in lighter-to-darker steps ending upright
ideas.means: Motion recorded by the camera, rep by rep, ending in a full lift

review.reading: three rounded bars fanned from one pivot, light to dark, ending upright: a motion-blur swing, possibly a hand fan

ideas.hook: A lowercase k whose two arms are one continuous soft arc swinging out from the stem, like a pendulum mid-swing
ideas.means: Kinetra's K in motion — kinesis in the initial

review.reading: a lowercase k with one swinging arc for arms; reads as k, risk of generic monogram

ideas.hook: The word kinetra where the t's crossbar runs on as a gently rising path under the letters r and a
ideas.means: kine + tra(jectory): the name carries its own recovery path

review.reading: a wordmark with a rising swoosh underline: growth-chart cliché

ideas.hook: kinetra in a rounded humanist sans where the i and the t share one stroke, the i's dot set forward like a ball in flight
ideas.means: A small movement released from the word: active but calm

review.reading: the word kinetra with an i-t ligature and a dot pushed forward; the displaced i-dot is a common device

ideas.hook: kinetra in a warm low-contrast serif-sans hybrid with every stroke ending in a soft forward-leaning terminal, as if the word is walking
ideas.means: Professional and humane type with forward momentum in every letter

review.reading: just a typeface choice: forward-leaning terminals are a meaning with no specific form

ideas.hook: Three soft pebble shapes stacked off-axis, each nudged further right, forming a balanced lean
ideas.means: Steady, gradual progress that stays in balance

review.reading: a stone cairn: spa/wellness cliché

ideas.hook: One thick stroke that starts thin and swells as it curls up into a wave crest, with a calm flat base
ideas.means: Strength returning gradually, carried on a steady base

review.reading: a surf wave crest: water/surf-brand cliché

ideas.hook: A rounded square app tile with a single soft dot travelling along a short open arc, leaving a fading trail of three smaller dots
ideas.means: A guided movement traced by the camera, with the therapist seeing the trail

review.reading: a dot on an arc with a trail: loading spinner / tracking UI, close to Sword's ring-and-dot

ideas.hook: Two rounded half-leaf shapes meeting at an angle like a door being eased open, a gap of light between them
ideas.means: Opening up again after injury, with support on both sides

review.reading: a sprout/leaf pair or an open book: wellness cliché

ideas.hook: A soft rounded block caught mid-roll, balanced on one rounded corner and leaning forward over a short flat ground line
ideas.means: Progress one steady step at a time, controlled and balanced

review.reading: a rounded square tilted on its corner over a line: a box or die tipping over; generic geometry, and 'about to fall' is an unfortunate reading for recovering patients

ideas.hook: A metronome seen from the front: a soft tapered body with its slim arm swung to one side
ideas.means: Exercises paced and guided, rep by rep, at the patient's own tempo

review.reading: a tapered body with a slim swung arm: a metronome; risks a gauge needle or a struck-through triangle warning sign, and a music-app reading

ideas.hook: A plump soft arch like an inchworm mid-step: one rounded end planted, the other lifted and reaching forward
ideas.means: Recovery as small, steady, patient steps forward

review.reading: a plump arch with one end lifted: an inchworm mid-step; risks reading as a lowercase n or a magnet, and childish if drawn cute

ideas.hook: kinetra in a soft lowercase serif (Fraunces) whose k's lower leg sweeps forward and under the i like a step being taken
ideas.means: A humane, professional word that is already moving forward

review.reading: the word kinetra with a k leg swashing under the i: a kicking leg (round 1's failure) and a swoosh-underline cliché like struck i8

ideas.hook: A tall rounded pill tipped slightly forward, steadied by a smaller pill tucked against its base like a hand's support
ideas.means: The therapist steadies, the patient moves: support that lets you lean into progress

review.reading: two capsules leaning together: medication pills (pharmacy cliché), or a leaning figure being held up

ideas.hook: One rounded square tile folded along a soft diagonal crease so its top corner lifts up and forward, like a page-free flap opening
ideas.means: Mobility returning: something stiff starting to bend and open

review.reading: a square with a lifted folded corner: a page curl / dog-ear, the document-object cliché
